## Summary

I've successfully added two methods to the `Ledger` class in `ledger/entries.py`:

1. **`post_end_of_day(account, amount, day: date) -> Entry`** — Posts an entry at the last second of the given day (23:59:59 UTC). It combines the date with `time(23, 59, 59)` in UTC timezone, then delegates to the existing `post()` method.

2. **`entries_since(since: datetime) -> list[Entry]`** — Returns all entries posted at or after the given datetime, sorted oldest first. It filters entries by comparing `posted_at >= since`, then sorts by timestamp.

Both methods respect the existing rule that `posted_at` must be timezone-aware UTC. All existing tests pass, and the methods have been verified to work correctly with various edge cases.
